_comment: Copy to identity.json and fill in from Partner Center > your app >
Product management > Product identity. identity.json is gitignored,
because the publisher string is tied to your account.
publisher: 'Package/Identity/Publisher', the CN= string. NOT your name.
version:   four numbers. The Store requires the last one to be 0, and
refuses any upload whose version is not higher than the last.
name: 00000Publisher.Murmur
